title: 五竹亭 Wuzhu Ting
subtitle: Chu T'ing, Bamboo Pavilion · Xiyang Lou

model.line: Simple massing of a European palace, assumed: sizes from the texts and the ruin polygons, position from the plan or the ruin. Not a reading of the 1786 engravings yet.
rows: pavilion (Q15: not drawn on the plan; five in a row is a guess): 6 × 6 m, eave 3.5 m, ridge 5 m
gallery: 5 × 2.4 m, eave 2.6 m, ridge 3.2 m

photos.title: 竹亭北面 Zhuting beimian, bamboo pavilions, north side (圆明园铜版画册, plate 9 of 20)
photos.creator: 伊兰泰 Yi Lantai (drawings); engraved by court workshops
photos.archive: 故宫博物院 Palace Museum, Beijing

facts.label: Destroyed
facts.value: Looted and burnt 1860; stone ruins stayed, further damage 1900 and after (S02 pp.142,218)

facts.label: Note
facts.value: Copper engraving no. 9 per S02. 5 Chinese-style pavilions linked by covered walks; pool and wall survive; pavilions gone (S02). Bamboo-clad (S06).
